product_overview: Web application for central and site-level solar monitoring, alarm/notification configuration, reporting, and a sequential billing workflow (energy confirmation → invoice → payment → receipt). The UI exposes dashboards, charts, events, and admin pages for configuration and user/permission management.
core_goals: Allow users to view national- and site-level real-time and historical energy/production data and visualizations.
Provide tools to create, preview, download and distribute operational reports and billing documents.
Support a controlled billing lifecycle (energy confirmation → invoice generation/approval → payment submission/verification → receipt issuance) with role-based responsibilities and audit trail.
Enable administrators to manage users, page/site access, alarm rules and notification channels so alerts reach the correct recipients.
Provide event and alarm analytics so operations teams can filter, inspect and act on recorded issues.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate into the system with username and password; on success the app stores token/permissions and navigates to the main landing page. (See login flow described in codebase and PRD.)
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter username -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See /main/overview
Navigate to /login -> Enter username -> Enter incorrect password -> Submit login form -> See invalid credentials message

features.name: Authorization Guard (Page Permissions)
features.description: Protect guarded pages by checking stored page permissions (pages list in localStorage); show a permission dialog and redirect when access is not allowed. This maps to the app guard and the RBAC described in the design spec (page 18–19).
user_flows: Navigate to /main/performance -> System checks stored page permissions -> See performance content when permission present
Navigate to /main/performance -> System checks stored page permissions -> If missing permission, see permission dialog and get redirected to /main/overview

features.name: Central Overview (National Dashboard & Map)
features.description: National-level dashboard showing system-wide KPIs and an interactive map with site icons; selecting a site presents a site summary. Visual layout and map behaviour are described on page 7 of the design spec.
user_flows: Navigate to /main/overview -> View system-wide performance indicators and map with site icons (map overview on page 7) -> Select a site on the map -> See site summary and current status

features.name: Performance & Trends (Central Comparative Charts)
features.description: Compare site performance across multiple metrics and time ranges (energy, yield, power vs irradiance). Users can select dates to review historical performance as described on pages 8–9.
user_flows: Navigate to /main/performance -> Select a date range -> View comparative performance charts and summary metrics
Navigate to /main/trend -> Select a date range -> View power vs. irradiance trend charts across sites

features.name: Site Monitoring — Dashboard, Realtime, Diagram, Charts
features.description: Site-level pages that show plant layout, real-time device statuses, detailed charts and a connectivity diagram for troubleshooting and daily monitoring (see pages 26–31).
user_flows: Navigate to /main/dashboard -> View plant overview, real-time power, Solar Profile and Energy Summary -> Select a time range -> Export chart data as XLSX or PNG
Navigate to /main/realtime -> Trigger data refresh -> View updated real-time device metrics and table of device statuses
Navigate to /main/diagram -> View system diagram and device connectivity
Navigate to /main/charts -> Select devices and parameters to compare -> Combine charts -> Export chart PNG or XLSX

features.name: Reports (Preview & Download)
features.description: Generate and preview operational reports (daily/monthly/yearly) by choosing type, date range and sites; view a live PDF preview and download the final report (page 10 and pages 31–32).
user_flows: Navigate to /main/reports -> Select report type, date range and site set -> See live report preview -> Download the report PDF

features.name: Billing & Billing Admin (Configuration and Workflow)
features.description: Admin interface for configuring billing parameters (meter mode, rates, schedule), assigning workflow responsibilities per step and managing site-specific billing configurations; supports the sequential billing lifecycle and the workflow diagram on page 33 and configuration UI shown on page 11.
user_flows: Navigate to /main/admin -> Configure global billing parameters (meter type, energy cost, FT, billing generation date and schedule) -> Save changes
Navigate to /main/admin -> Add or edit site billing configuration and assign workflow roles -> Save configuration

Navigate to /main/reports -> Locate billing record in Billing List -> Open billing record -> Review Confirmation Energy PDF -> Approve to proceed to invoice generation -> Review Invoice PDF -> Approve to request customer signature

features.name: Billing Workflow — Energy Confirmation to Receipt
features.description: In-app workflow to review and progress billing records through energy confirmation, invoice generation/approval, payment verification and receipt issuance. The end-to-end flow and responsibilities are described on pages 33–49 (workflow diagram and step details).
user_flows: Navigate to /main/reports -> Locate billing record -> Open record to review Confirmation Energy PDF -> Approve confirmation -> System generates invoice

From billing record -> Review Invoice PDF -> Approve invoice to mark as 'Ready for customer signature' -> After customer uploads payment proof (via provided upload link), open billing record -> Verify payment proof -> Issue receipt and mark billing Complete

features.name: User Management & Page/Site Access Control
features.description: Manage users, roles, signatures and page/site-level access. Administrators can add users, configure signatures and assign per-page and per-site permissions (see pages 14–19).
user_flows: Navigate to /main/setting -> View user list -> Add new user with role/company details -> Save user
Navigate to /main/setting -> Edit user -> Configure page access checkboxes and site access list (page-level and site-level) -> Save changes
Navigate to /main/setting -> Open signature management for a user -> Upload or draw signature -> Preview and save

features.name: Alarm & Event Configuration
features.description: Create and manage alarm rules with expressions, schedules and severity levels. Users can enable/disable alarms and control notification behavior; alarm config UI and examples are on page 20–21.
user_flows: Navigate to /main/event -> Open alarm settings -> Create new alarm by entering equipment, asset, message and level -> Define trigger expression and schedule -> Save alarm
Navigate to /main/event -> Toggle alarm enable/disable -> Toggle alarm notification on/off -> Save changes

features.name: Event Analytics & Event Viewer
features.description: View and filter recorded events by status, device type or date; inspect event details and trend summaries to triage operational issues (see page 30).
user_flows: Navigate to /main/events -> Filter events by status, device type or date range -> Select an event from the list -> View detailed event information and timestamp

features.name: Notification Channels (Telegram / LINE / Email / Teams)
features.description: Configure notification channels used by the alarm subsystem: create, edit or delete channels and supply platform-specific credentials (access tokens, chat IDs). Supported channel types and UI are described on page 22–24.
user_flows: Navigate to /main/setting -> Open Notifications/Channels list -> Click to add a new channel -> Enter channel name and select type (Telegram/LINE/Email/Teams) -> Provide access token and recipient IDs -> Activate channel and save
Navigate to /main/setting -> Edit existing notification channel -> Toggle Active/Inactive -> Save changes

features.name: Realtime / Historian Data Views
features.description: Fetch and display realtime, at-time and historian data for dashboards and charts; users can refresh data and view updated graphs and tables (service endpoints are getrealtime / getattime / gethisdata in the codebase).
user_flows: Navigate to /main/dashboard -> Trigger data refresh -> View updated realtime values and production charts
Navigate to /main/charts -> Request at-time or historical series -> See plotted historical/attime data and export if needed

user_interactions: Approve billing or update billing workflow steps
